meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭出符合约定的可渲染合成结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要编排多素材画面并需要一个稳定可复用的创作约定。
copy.tagline_en: Set up media scenes that follow clear timing and rendering rules.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build layered compositions and want stable, predictable rendering.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范编写视频项目的 HTML：用 data-* 属性安排每个片段的时长与顺序，配置子组合、变量和媒体，并遵守确定性渲染规则，使结果可预期、可通过命令验证。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、修改或检查 HyperFrames 组合 HTML，或编写 STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md 等计划文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个最小可渲染的 HyperFrames 组合 HTML。
say.note: 按最小骨架开始搭建项目。

say.note: 设置片段在时间轴上的起点。

say.text: 检查我的组合文件有没有违反确定性规则。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will author HyperFrames video-project HTML per the spec: using data-* attributes to set each clip's duration and order, wiring sub-compositions, variables and media, and obeying deterministic-render rules so output is predictable and verifiable via commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, modify, or check HyperFrames composition HTML, or to write plan files such as STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md.
